name: CM&F Group
short_description: Individual malpractice cover for counselors, social workers, psychologists and students, priced online: $1M per claim/$6M aggregate with HIPAA and defense sublimits.
long_description: CM&F Group sells individual professional liability insurance to healthcare professionals, including licensed mental health counselors, LPCs, LCSWs, psychologists and counseling students, plus group policies for behavioral health groups and mental health clinics. It describes placing coverage with partner carriers. Its mental health policy lists limits of $1M per claim and $6M aggregate, with defense costs paid outside the limits. Listed sublimits on the LMHC policy include $35,000 for information privacy (including HIPAA), $25,000 per policy period for sexual misconduct defense, loss of earnings up to $2,500 a day ($35,000 aggregate) and medical expenses for others up to $25,000 per claim. CM&F offers both occurrence and claims-made forms; its NBCC member page describes occurrence policies. Prices are shown after an online questionnaire rather than published. Students can move to new-graduate rates near graduation.
one_liner: Online-quoted malpractice for counselors, social workers, psychologists and students.
best_for: Licensed counselors (LMHC, LPC) and LCSWs who want an online quote
Clinicians who want defense costs paid outside the $1M/$6M limits
Counseling students who want to move to new-graduate rates at graduation
Behavioral health groups and clinics looking for a group policy
not_for: Clinicians who want a premium published before entering details
Buyers who need the carrier name and rating stated up front; confirm it on the quote
Clinicians who want a mental-health-only insurer; CM&F covers many healthcare professions

notes.solo-therapist: Individual policy at $1M per claim/$6M aggregate, defense costs outside limits, $35,000 HIPAA/privacy sublimit; quoted online.
notes.group-practice: Separate group liability products for behavioral health groups and mental health clinics.

compliance.notes: Insurance provider; HIPAA BAAs and security certifications do not apply. The policy includes an information privacy (HIPAA) sublimit.

faqs.q: What limits does CM&F offer mental health professionals?
faqs.a: CM&F's mental health policy lists $1 million per claim and $6 million aggregate, with legal defense costs for covered claims paid without reducing those limits.
The LMHC policy lists an information privacy sublimit, including HIPAA, of up to $35,000.

faqs.q: Is CM&F coverage occurrence or claims-made?
faqs.a: CM&F offers both. Its NBCC member page describes occurrence-based policies; claims-made can cost less but may need tail coverage.
Yes. CM&F sells counselor student liability insurance and offers new-graduate rates when students transition to licensed practice.
